items.title: Chipotle (CMG) Unveils Sneak It In Hoodie With An Insulated Food Pocket
items.summary: Chipotle Mexican Grill (NYSE:CMG) released a limited edition "Sneak It In" hoodie that features an insulated pocket for hot food. The hoodie links directly to a holiday promotion that pairs Chipotle themed streetwear with the brand's food focused product experience. Chipotle is tying the apparel drop to gift card and loyalty reward activity to spark digital engagement during the holiday period.
